body: Check the active layer type, visibility, folder locks, alpha lock and any retained Puppet Warp. Bucket/gradient/retouch need raster destinations. Vector geometry tools need a compatible vector source; painting a retained warp requires Bake or reopening its pins. The forbidden cursor/status reason explains known restrictions without a modal alert. Panning, selection and sampling often remain available while painting is blocked.

sections.title: Where the work went
body: A hidden folder hides descendants; a clipped layer needs a valid visible base in its own group. Timeline Solo is preview-only and respects saved visibility. A held/reused drawing shares artwork across exposures. An active selection can confine a stroke to a small area. An imported image and its initial positioning are separate Undo operations; cancelling positioning does not remove the layer. Use History to inspect retained edits, and save before reorganizing important projects.

sections.title: Build, media and recovery checks
body: CMake cannot find Qt: confirm the SDK contains Widgets/SVG/Concurrent/SQL/Multimedia and set CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH to its platform directory, not a random include folder. Missing Qt Test affects testing builds. Reconfigure after changing optional runtime inputs.
No audio/video preview or MP4 encoder: check the packaged Qt Multimedia backend and actual codec availability. A source file can be retained even when local decoding is unavailable.

Project already open: another writer lease is active. Do not bypass its catalog protections to force simultaneous editing. Missing/corrupt catalogs should be investigated, not replaced with an empty database. Reopen recovery when offered and use saved-state backups for independent copies.

sections.title: Report useful evidence
body: Record the app/source version, platform, selected tool/layer, steps, expected result and actual status/error text. Save a small reproducible project when possible. Source tests and synthetic tablet events cannot certify physical tablet feel. The current validation report states automated results and remaining native/device/platform acceptance separately.

features.title: Drawing, Animation and Movie projects
features.summary: Start with a project type matching your immediate work.
details: Drawing collects images; Animation collects single-shot documents; Movie organizes mixed content with folders and tags.
workflow: Projects → New project → choose a type → name/location → Create.
limits: A Movie dashboard is an organizer, not a finished multi-shot editing pipeline.

features.title: Search, pin and archive projects
features.summary: Keep local projects easy to find without changing their files.
details: Search, name/last-opened sorting, grid/list and Pinned/Archived views operate on recent entries.
workflow: Use the Projects search or card actions to pin, archive or restore.
limits: Removing a recent entry does not delete its project directory.

features.title: Previewed canvas creation
features.summary: Choose size and background before opening the drawing.
details: Landscape/Square/Portrait/Custom, width/height, ratio lock and orientation swap feed a proportional preview.
workflow: New drawing → name/dimensions/background → review → Create drawing.
limits: The initial preset set is deliberately small; a colored background becomes a locked raster layer.

features.title: Independent native document tabs
features.summary: Keep several drawings or shots open with separate state.
details: Each tab owns its Canvas, Document, history, dimensions, playhead, selection and view.
workflow: Select items with Cmd/Ctrl or Shift → Open selected → switch tabs.
limits: Open documents remain loaded in memory; there is no automatic inactive-tab eviction.

features.title: Project-owned media imports
features.summary: Copy reference media into the project without altering originals.
details: Reviewed image/video/audio imports publish a batch only after successful copying.
workflow: Assets → Import assets → Add files → destination/tags → confirm.
limits: No drag/drop import, content-hash deduplication or automatic live placement is implemented.

features.title: Deliberate media preview
features.summary: Inspect images and play sound/video when you choose.
details: Images load asynchronously; audio/video expose Play/Pause, Stop, seek and duration.
workflow: Select an asset and use its inspector playback controls.
limits: Selection never autoplays; codecs depend on the runtime and video/audio cards use source-kind icons.

features.title: Folders, tags and reversible removal
features.summary: Organize project content separately from brush-stroke history.
details: Item actions rename, change folder/tags, remove and restore; Organization Undo reverses supported metadata edits.
workflow: Use an item context/overflow action or the selected-asset inspector.
limits: Remove retains original bytes; permanent delete, folder reparent/rename and organization Redo are absent.

features.title: Move editable documents to Assets
features.summary: Change collection membership while preserving the native source.
details: Moves keep the same item ID, media/revision path and valid open tabs.
workflow: Native item → Move to Assets → choose folder/tags → confirm.
limits: A move does not flatten/render/duplicate a document or create a linked external asset.

features.title: Docked and floating workspace panels
features.summary: Arrange tools around the canvas and remember useful layouts.
details: Ordinary docks support tabbing/floating; Toolbox uses an independent full-height icon column.
workflow: Open Panels, arrange docks and save a named personal workspace.
limits: Focused tabs omit Shots/review collection navigation and block layout changes during unresolved edits.

features.title: Pan, zoom and rotate the working view
features.summary: Navigate artwork without editing its pixels.
details: Canvas, Navigator, Fit sheet and Actual size support view navigation.
workflow: Use Space/middle drag, wheel or the View/Navigator actions.
limits: Working-view navigation is distinct from raster transforms and shot-camera animation.

features.title: View-only canvas mirror
features.summary: Flip the drawing view to inspect proportions.
details: Shift+M changes working-view orientation and matching pointer mapping.
workflow: Focus the canvas and press Shift+M, or use View → Mirror canvas.
limits: Saved pixels, artwork Undo and exported orientation do not change.

features.title: Canvas display smoothing
features.summary: Choose smooth display sampling with the AA control.
details: The remembered preference affects canvas presentation.
workflow: Toggle AA in the header or its View action.
limits: The preference does not modify saved artwork or exported pixels.

features.title: Slider and exact-entry properties
features.summary: Move quickly or type a precise scalar value.
details: Shared responsive rows keep sliders synchronized with compact numeric entry.
workflow: Drag a track, or type and Enter; Escape cancels the current numeric edit.
limits: Control ranges and units depend on the property; this is not a new drawing-engine capability.

features.title: Tool groups, tags and search
features.summary: Keep frequently used tools direct and recognizable.
details: Toolbox groups, Tools rows/grid, search, tags and Tool Management organize independent tool definitions.
workflow: Choose a group, filter Tools, or open Tool Management to edit membership.
limits: Tool organization Undo is separate from artwork history; metadata browsing alone does not activate painting.

features.title: Native raster brush painting
features.summary: Paint pressure-aware marks into editable raster tiles.
details: Size, hardness, opacity, flow, spacing and supported input dynamics share one native renderer.
workflow: Select an editable raster layer, choose a brush and paint.
limits: No wet-pigment physics, bristle simulation or other-product rendering equivalence is claimed.

features.title: Direct brush quick settings
features.summary: Tune common brush values beside the canvas.
details: Size, Opacity, Flow, Hardness, Smoothing and pressure-size are directly exposed.
workflow: Select a brush and adjust Tool Properties before the next stroke.
limits: Opacity caps a stroke; Flow changes each impression, so they have different effects.

features.title: Tabbed advanced brush settings
features.summary: Reach detailed native settings through direct category tabs.
details: The wrench opens a remembered category rail and synchronized advanced controls.
workflow: Tool Properties → wrench → category → change settings → Close.
limits: Committed tool edits remain when closing; they do not rewrite previous strokes.

features.title: Rotate and squash a brush tip
features.summary: See tip geometry as you adjust it.
details: A direct tip widget and angle/roundness/flip controls edit the actual native tip.
workflow: Open Tip shape and drag its rotation/squash handles or enter values.
limits: Sampled imagery retains its own resolution; compression does not create new detail.

features.title: Live stamp-spacing preview
features.summary: Control continuous paint versus separated impressions.
details: Spacing is shared between General and Tip shape and shown by a strip preview.
workflow: Adjust spacing and test the next stroke.
limits: Large colored stamps at close spacing can cost substantial CPU time.

features.title: Input response graphs
features.summary: Map supported pen inputs through editable curves.
details: Response graphs provide movable points and Linear/Soft/Firm/Invert presets for relevant channels.
workflow: Choose the input/channel and edit its graph or preset.
limits: Available sources depend on the native channel and actual tablet input.

features.title: Size, angle and roundness dynamics
features.summary: Vary the shape of impressions through input and seeded jitter.
details: Supported pressure/tilt/direction/fade controllers combine with native shape parameters.
workflow: Advanced → Shape dynamics → choose input and response/jitter.
limits: This is native dynamics, not complete Photoshop descriptor or engine compatibility.

features.title: Pressure-driven opacity and flow
features.summary: Separate mark coverage from geometric response.
details: Transfer maps supported input/jitter to opacity and flow.
workflow: Advanced → Transfer → choose channel input and curve.
limits: Alpha locks and selection coverage still constrain the resulting stroke.

features.title: Scatter and repeated dabs
features.summary: Distribute multiple impressions across or along a path.
details: Scatter axes/count settings have a visual distribution preview.
workflow: Open Scattering and adjust distribution, count and available dynamics.
limits: High counts and broad tips increase work; scattered tips are not independent editable vector objects.

features.title: Native brush texture
features.summary: Use a pattern to modulate paint coverage.
details: Texture thumbnails and supported scale/position controls edit embedded native texture resources.
workflow: Advanced → Texture → choose a pattern and tune its coverage.
limits: ABR texture-resource definitions are not automatically imported with exact source behavior.

features.title: Secondary-mask dual brush
features.summary: Combine a second native mask with the primary tip.
details: Secondary tip geometry/distribution modulates supported native marks.
workflow: Advanced → Dual brush → enable and choose the secondary mask.
limits: Source-application dual-brush descriptors and rendering are not reproduced by ABR import.

features.title: Seeded brush color variation
features.summary: Vary applicable color channels per stroke or impression.
details: HSV/purity and supported color choices can vary deterministically; colored tips require explicit image-color variation.
workflow: Advanced → Color dynamics → enable applicable channels.
limits: Neutral ink cannot display saturation variation like a colorful source image.

features.title: Captured brush symmetry
features.summary: Draw linked mirrored or radial copies from one stroke.
details: Symmetry presets and an editable center constrain captured brush copies.
workflow: Select a symmetry tile and position its center before painting.
limits: Copies share editable source on vector replay; this is not independent object duplication.

features.title: Pen-pose preview and overrides
features.summary: Inspect and control supported direction/tilt behavior.
details: An interactive pen diagram exposes supported pose settings and override states.
workflow: Open the relevant brush pose page and adjust the diagram or precise controls.
limits: Actual hardware sensors determine which physical inputs arrive.

features.title: Stationary airbrush build-up
features.summary: Deposit paint while the pointer remains pressed and still.
details: General settings enable a native build-up rate while preserving stroke opacity behavior.
workflow: Enable airbrush build-up and hold contact on an editable layer.
limits: Hold-to-shape and adjustable Shift-line interactions retain their dedicated dwell rules.

features.title: 219 original built-in brush recipes
features.summary: Begin with native inking, paint, texture and subject-oriented configurations.
details: The installed set spans starter, catalog, expanded and specialized families with category/tag search.
workflow: Open Brush Management and filter by category, type or tag, then Use.
limits: These are original configurations and procedural assets, not borrowed commercial brush packs.

features.title: Create and batch-organize brushes
features.summary: Build independent tools and manage their metadata.
details: New/Duplicate, categories, tags, group membership and separate organization Undo cover library management.
workflow: Brush Management → New or select several rows → metadata/group actions.
limits: Shared tool/image limits apply; deleting definitions does not delete captured artwork resources.

features.title: Reported Photoshop ABR import
features.summary: Bring supported tips and selected descriptor settings into the native engine.
details: Names/UUIDs, geometry, spacing and selected shape/transfer/scatter controls are mapped with compatibility reports.
workflow: Brush Management → Import → select an ABR → inspect compatibility details.
limits: Texture/dual/color definitions, wet/bristle behavior and exact Photoshop rendering remain unsupported.

features.title: Foreground image stamps
features.summary: Paint an imported coverage mask with the current color.
details: Transparent images use alpha; opaque sources use dark-on-white coverage.
workflow: Import a Stamp image and choose the foreground color.
limits: Source images are bounded, fitted for storage and not modified on disk.

features.title: Colored image stamps
features.summary: Retain source image color and transparency in a brush.
details: Colored tips share size, dynamics, scatter and selection behavior with the native engine.
workflow: Create/import a Colored stamp and paint or enable placement.
limits: Opaque backgrounds remain opaque; foreground color does not tint the tip by default.

features.title: Multi-image dynamic stamp sets
features.summary: Cycle, shuffle or weight between 2–16 tip images.
details: Ordered/Random/Shuffle, roots, thumbnails and per-tip size/rotation/saturation variation control a set.
workflow: New brush → Dynamic stamp → add images → interpretation/name → Use.
limits: Each dynamic source fits within 512 × 512 and shared library budgets still apply.

features.title: Editable single-stamp placement
features.summary: Position a pending image impression before acceptance.
details: Adjust stamp is remembered independently as a tool interaction preference.
workflow: Enable Adjust stamp for a sampled brush, place and adjust its pending impression.
limits: The toggle is separate from brush rendering resources and existing captured strokes.

features.title: Curve-following Ribbon brushes
features.summary: Join a source image along a drawn path.
details: Ribbon respects source proportions, Repeat length and supported width dynamics.
workflow: Advanced → Tip shape → Ribbon → set width/repeat → draw.
limits: Contact alone does not place the full motif; very tight corners can compress its imagery.

features.title: Architectural Repeat brushes
features.summary: Repeat connected motifs along a path without independent stamp gaps.
details: Complete repeats retain source selection/phase, optional alternate flipping and editable vector replay.
workflow: Advanced → Tip shape → Repeat → set Repeat length and draw.
limits: Ordinary stamp spacing/scatter and Adjust stamp are not connected-strip parameters.

features.title: Phase-stable native pattern tones
features.summary: Paint dots, lines, crosshatch, diamond, noise or faded dots.
details: Frequency, density, angle and offsets operate independently of the brush tip.
workflow: Advanced → Patterns and tones → choose type → tune coverage.
limits: Frequency uses cycles per 100 artwork pixels; there is no automatic print-LPI/DPI conversion.

features.title: Full-color image surface tiles
features.summary: Repeat a colored transparent image beneath native brush coverage.
details: Tile width/height choose artwork-space repeats without replacing the primary tip.
workflow: Patterns and tones → Image → import a tile → set repeat dimensions.
limits: Fine minified patterns use bounded filtering and shared image/resource budgets.

features.title: Explicit perspective pattern plane
features.summary: Map a surface image onto a four-corner artwork-space quad.
details: Canvas-aware Fit to artwork and preview/exact corner controls set a deliberate 2D projection.
workflow: Patterns and tones → Perspective plane → adjust quad or Fit to artwork.
limits: It is not linked automatically to guides/vanishing points or 3D cameras; paint outside the quad is transparent.

features.title: Seeded clustered spray
features.summary: Distribute brush particles in controlled clusters.
details: Cluster count/radius/spread/bias/span/direction replace ordinary scatter offsets.
workflow: Advanced → Scattering → Clustered spray → tune the distribution preview.
limits: High particle counts increase work; random choices remain tied to the captured stroke seed.

features.title: Foreground tint for colored tips
features.summary: Shift an image tip toward the current drawing color.
details: Tint changes hue/saturation while preserving source brightness shading and transparency.
workflow: Advanced → Color dynamics → Foreground tint → choose amount.
limits: Zero retains the source palette; HSV random variation is a separate opt-in control.

features.title: Timestamped brush speed response
features.summary: Change brush size or opacity according to drawing speed.
details: Signed response uses artwork pixels per second, with retained samples for vector replay.
workflow: Advanced → Transfer → Speed response → reference speed and signed amounts.
limits: Canvas zoom and event batching do not define velocity; this is not automatic stroke stabilization.

features.title: Mask-shaped brush pointer
features.summary: See a sampled tip silhouette instead of a generic circle.
details: Tip transform/pose and view scale affect outlines, including transparent holes and islands.
workflow: Hover with a sampled brush and inspect its pointer before contact.
limits: It shows representative coverage, not guaranteed final opacity after flow, scatter and other effects.

features.title: Weighted, pressure and direction tip selection
features.summary: Choose multi-tip images deterministically and align their roots.
details: Random/Ordered/Shuffle/Pressure/Direction choose frames; draggable roots keep a motif base on its path.
workflow: Advanced → Tip shape → set selection mode, weight/order and root cross.
limits: Up to sixteen images share a bounded atlas; roots are not connected-strip parameters.

features.title: Zoom-consistent Smooth filtering
features.summary: Reduce high-frequency wobble with a moderate trailing filter.
details: Smoothing strength uses logical view distance, including camera zoom.
workflow: Choose Smooth and tune Smoothing from 0–100.
limits: More strength adds lag/rounding; physical pen latency is not established by software fixtures.

features.title: Strong stabilizer with dead zone
features.summary: Use a longer trailing leash for deliberate cleanup.
details: Strong exposes a pulled-string Stabilizer; General adds Dead zone and Finish stroke.
workflow: Choose Strong, then tune strength/dead zone and test your working zoom.
limits: High strength can suppress small loops; pathological input can exceed bounded completion history.

features.title: Modifier-constrained brush lines
features.summary: Draw axis-aligned or arbitrary-angle straight strokes without changing brushes.
details: Command/Ctrl chooses artwork axes; Shift previews an adjustable straight line using current brush resources.
workflow: Hold the modifier before contact, drag and release.
limits: The mode is captured at contact and bypasses ordinary freehand guide/filter behavior.

features.title: Hold-to-shape suggestions
features.summary: Pause a supported freehand gesture to preview a cleaner shape.
details: A 0.7-second pause can fit lines, arcs, circles, ellipses, rectangles or triangles with candidate choices.
workflow: Draw and hold, lift, then choose a fit or Original.
limits: Arbitrary scribbles need not match; there are no new post-fit node handles.

features.title: Raster and vector geometric shapes
features.summary: Create lines, rectangles, ellipses, polygons and curves.
details: Stroke/fill controls feed raster pixels or editable vector paths according to destination.
workflow: Choose a Shape tool, define its geometry and finish the gesture.
limits: Polygon/cubic Curve/Arc have distinct click sequences; invalid geometry is rejected.

features.title: Three-point editable Arc
features.summary: Define an arc with endpoints and a third bend point.
details: The live quadratic curve passes through the chosen third point.
workflow: Drag endpoints, lift, move to bend, then click or Enter.
limits: The existing four-click cubic Curve is a separate tool.

features.title: Inline HSV color picker
features.summary: Choose foreground/background colors directly in the workspace.
details: Visible chips and an interactive picker feed native painting tools.
workflow: Use Colors and choose the desired foreground.
limits: Colored image stamps retain their own colors unless explicit variation/tint is selected.

features.title: Global named palettes and swatches
features.summary: Save frequently reused drawing colors.
details: Palette/swatch creation, rename/replace/delete and a direct plus action persist beside workspace preferences.
workflow: Choose/create a palette and save the current color as a swatch.
limits: These are global libraries, not project-owned character role palettes; limits are 64 × 256.

features.title: Composite, layer and reference sampling
features.summary: Pick color from the appropriate local image source.
details: Eyedropper remembers per-tool sampling source and samples References images when active.
workflow: Choose the source, then click/drag the artwork or reference image.
limits: A reference artwork layer is different from an imported References image or project asset.

features.title: Multistop linear and radial gradients
features.summary: Paint a controlled color ramp through the active selection.
details: A stop strip supports 2–32 stops, transparency, reordering and reversal.
workflow: Choose Linear/Radial Gradient, edit stops and drag on the raster canvas.
limits: The committed result is ordinary raster paint, not a live gradient layer.

features.title: Six native retouch brushes
features.summary: Smudge, mix, blur, sharpen, dodge or burn raster artwork.
details: Pressure scales diameter/strength; locks and feathered selections remain active.
workflow: Choose the matching Retouch tool and sweep the intended raster area.
limits: Algorithms are local approximations, not wet pigment simulation or nondestructive adjustment layers.

features.title: Editable sampled-brush vector strokes
features.summary: Keep a brush centerline and its replay resources editable.
details: Captured input, seed, settings, dabs and embedded tip/texture images remain owned by the stroke.
workflow: Create a Vector layer and draw with supported Drawing brushes.
limits: Bitmap tip detail remains sampled and large geometry edits may spread captured impressions.

features.title: Path transforms and Bézier nodes
features.summary: Move entire vector paths or adjust individual anchors/handles.
details: Transform/Nodes/Width tabs provide direct canvas manipulation and exact appearance controls.
workflow: Vector Editing → Path Edit → select a path → choose a tab.
limits: Position locks and compatible animation-source restrictions protect geometry.

features.title: Local width controls and Width Brush
features.summary: Thicken or thin an editable contour where needed.
details: Width handles/profile points and a radius/strength correction brush edit retained source width.
workflow: Choose Width in Path Edit or use Width Brush on a selected vector source.
limits: Captured symmetry copies update together; scattered independent dabs are not separate target paths.

features.title: Path and swept-region simplification
features.summary: Reduce redundant anchors within a chosen tolerance.
details: Selected path/layer actions and Simplify Brush preserve necessary curve/width detail.
workflow: Choose Simplify selected path/layer or sweep with Simplify Brush.
limits: A path already within tolerance can legitimately keep the same nodes.

features.title: Pressure-aware Vector Nudge
features.summary: Push a local contour area while retaining its editable source.
details: Radius/strength and smooth falloff evaluate each drag from its original snapshot.
workflow: Vector Editing → Vector Nudge → press/drag a contour → release.
limits: Path-morph animation, position locks and singular symmetry pushes may refuse the edit atomically.

features.title: Whole, segment and intersection erasing
features.summary: Trim vector sources using the appropriate geometric boundary.
details: Intersection mode cuts between true centerline crossings on the active vector layer and preserves editable fragments.
workflow: Choose Vector Eraser mode and sweep the intended interval.
limits: Tangencies/coincident spans are not crossings; no-crossing contours use whole-stroke fallback.

features.title: Editable Unicode artwork text
features.summary: Place text as a retained Text-layer source.
details: Font/style/alignment/color and inline multiline editing remain editable after save/reopen.
workflow: Text tool → click canvas → type → Cmd/Ctrl+Enter.
limits: Fonts are not embedded; text cels and text morph animation are not implemented.

features.title: Point bucket with gap closing
features.summary: Fill one raster region using a selected sampling source.
details: Tolerance, gap closing and antialiased-edge recovery preserve the normal fill workflow.
workflow: Choose Paint bucket → Point, set source/options and click the region.
limits: Gap closing is morphological boundary processing, not inference of arbitrary missing line art.

features.title: Grow or shrink a fill under ink
features.summary: Adjust fill coverage from −20 to +20 artwork pixels.
details: Growth protects destination ink and avoids disconnected matching regions; shrinking contracts the region.
workflow: Set Bucket Expansion and test on a separate color layer.
limits: Broad blurred boundaries can still need manual repair; this does not change source outlines.

features.title: Enclose multiple closed regions
features.summary: Color several fully enclosed line-art regions in one gesture.
details: A freehand loop selects which source-closed regions receive the fill.
workflow: Bucket → Enclose → loop around closed regions → release.
limits: The loop does not close open artwork; outside/cut/open regions are skipped and opaque flats are boundaries.

features.title: Persistent fill-reference layers
features.summary: Read ink from multiple marked layers while painting elsewhere.
details: Layer/folder marks persist, support Undo and can be read while hidden or locked.
workflow: Mark outline sources in Layers and choose Reference as the fill source.
limits: Marks are document-owned and distinct from References images; resource/sampling budgets apply.

features.title: Shape, lasso, wand and color selections
features.summary: Build raster coverage with Replace/Add/Subtract/Intersect.
details: Rectangle/ellipse/polygon/lasso and color-tolerance tools share painting constraints.
workflow: Choose a selection tool and combination mode, then define coverage.
limits: Current selection is transient workspace state and is not exported or recovered after reopen.

features.title: Feathered and named selections
features.summary: Soften a boundary and save important geometry.
details: Feather 0–100 pixels applies to supported tools; named entries save geometry/feather with Undo.
workflow: Set Feather; use the named selection save/load/delete actions.
limits: At most 64 named selections per shot; active unnamed coverage is not persistent.

features.title: Alpha-aware cut, copy and paste
features.summary: Move raster snapshots between layers while preserving transparent edges.
details: Internal metadata preserves original artwork coordinates; external images center in the frame.
workflow: Use canvas Cmd/Ctrl+X/C/V or Paste into active layer.
limits: Vector/text copying produces a raster snapshot; cut requires an unlocked raster destination with alpha lock off.

features.title: Import image as an artwork layer
features.summary: Place external pixels in a native editable raster layer.
details: Supported Qt images retain transparency, fit oversized content and start positioning immediately.
workflow: File → Import image as artwork layer → choose file → position.
limits: Cancelling positioning retains the new layer; importing and positioning are separate Undo steps.

features.title: Previewed raster move, scale and rotate
features.summary: Adjust pixels from their retained original before applying once.
details: Canvas handles and exact controls share Apply/Cancel; a completed edit is one Undo.
workflow: Press T, manipulate the box and Apply/Enter.
limits: Final raster pixels crop to the drawing extent; repeated separate applied resampling can lose detail.

features.title: Perspective and grid warp transforms
features.summary: Distort selected layers while preserving their hierarchy.
details: Four perspective corners or a nine-handle grid operate through the advanced transform path.
workflow: Select layers/folder → Perspective Transform or Warp → adjust → Apply.
limits: Mesh warp requires rasterized vector/text and refuses folded/crossed geometry.

features.title: Transform only the selection boundary
features.summary: Reposition a selection without altering underlying artwork.
details: Boundary geometry has direct handles, Apply/Cancel and Undo.
workflow: Select → Transform selection boundary → adjust → Apply.
limits: It changes selection geometry, not pixel paint or a 3D camera.

features.title: Reopenable pin-based Puppet Warp
features.summary: Keep original raster pixels and deformation settings after Apply.
details: Free pins, density, multiselect, Reset and Show mesh retain a per-layer editable source.
workflow: Edit → Puppet Warp → add/move pins → Apply; reopen from Layers.
limits: Raster only; 64 pins, density 4–32, no pin rotation/animation or silhouette-derived mesh.

features.title: Explicit Puppet Warp baking
features.summary: Return a retained deformation to ordinary raster painting.
details: Bake keeps the rendered appearance and removes the mesh/source; Undo restores them.
workflow: Edit → Bake Puppet Warp or use its Layers context action.
limits: Retained warps block direct pixel editing until baked or adjusted through the mesh.

features.title: Raster, vector, text, Notes and 3D layers
features.summary: Use source types suited to paint, paths, text or reference scenes.
details: Rows identify their type and common properties; folders compose nested content.
workflow: Create the needed layer from Layers or the dedicated authoring tool.
limits: Drawing containers and particular effects retain explicit type restrictions.

features.title: One-gesture layer visibility sweeps
features.summary: Show or hide a sequence of layers directly.
details: Drag through the eye column to apply the initial visibility state with one Undo.
workflow: Click/drag the eye column; Escape cancels an active sweep.
limits: Eye changes do not change the active drawing target and hidden parents still hide descendants.

features.title: Twelve blend modes and live opacity
features.summary: Compose layer color and coverage with precise controls.
details: Normal plus eleven supported blend modes and synchronized opacity slider/entry share renderer behavior.
workflow: Select one layer/folder and adjust its header appearance controls.
limits: Opacity/blend header edits are disabled for multi-selection; no unlimited blend-mode parity is claimed.

features.title: Full, alpha and position locks
features.summary: Protect the aspect of a layer that should stay fixed.
details: Full locks protect content/structure; alpha lock preserves raster coverage; position lock protects geometry.
workflow: Toggle the relevant Layer property icon and inspect inherited folder locks.
limits: Alpha lock on an empty layer remains empty; inherited full locks require unlocking the parent.

features.title: Nested folders and drag organization
features.summary: Group and reorder artwork with hierarchy-aware feedback.
details: Multi-selection, sibling grouping, duplicate and drop insertion respect clipping and locks.
workflow: Select Layers rows and drag, or choose New Folder around siblings.
limits: Static/drawing stacks allow 64 nodes and nesting up to eight levels; cyclic destinations are refused.

features.title: Coverage-preserving clipping runs
features.summary: Paint detail inside the nearest sibling base.
details: Clipped layers use base alpha within their group; group opacity/blend apply through shared rules.
workflow: Place a layer over its base and enable Clipping.
limits: Clipping does not cross folders; structural edits may require selecting the complete run.

features.title: Production Notes layers
features.summary: Keep sheet annotations out of movie-frame artwork.
details: Notes membership propagates through folders and permits supported production margins.
workflow: Create/toggle a Notes layer and draw annotations there.
limits: Mixed Notes/artwork flattening has explicit guards; Notes are not ordinary movie-output paint.

features.title: Guarded merge, flatten and rasterize
features.summary: Bake selected editable structure when the composition is valid.
details: Merge Down, Flatten Image and Rasterize commit reversible artwork edits.
workflow: Use the matching Layers context/header command.
limits: Unsupported locks/blend/clipping/Notes relationships are refused rather than silently changing the result.

features.title: Selection-derived and painted masks
features.summary: Hide content while preserving its source pixels.
details: Create white/from-selection masks, Hide/Reveal paint, invert/fill/disable/remove and direct strength controls.
workflow: Effects → Mask → create → enable paint → Hide/Reveal.
limits: Painted mask imagery is shared source data across animation frames, not new per-frame mask drawings.

features.title: Independent mask placement and feather
features.summary: Move and soften a mask relative to its layer.
details: Position, scale, rotation, opacity, feather and inversion retain validated local properties.
workflow: Effects → Mask → Placement → adjust slider/entry controls.
limits: There are no canvas mask-transform handles or mask-pivot editor in this pass.

features.title: Native blur, shadow and glow
features.summary: Add live softening and lighting silhouettes.
details: Blur, offset shadow and glow retain source settings and use the shared compositor.
workflow: Open the matching Effects category, enable it and tune its controls.
limits: CPU preview/effect memory budgets apply; heavy stacks can run below target playback FPS.

features.title: Color correction and adjustment layers
features.summary: Adjust exposure, contrast, saturation and hue without repainting source.
details: Exposure uses linear light; other controls preserve alpha using unassociated sRGB color.
workflow: Effects → Color or create an appropriate adjustment layer.
limits: Adjustment scope is lower siblings in the same folder; unsupported effect types remain unavailable.

features.title: Live outer layer outline
features.summary: Follow a layer/folder alpha silhouette with an editable border.
details: Static width 0–128 source pixels and RGB color persist independently of the source.
workflow: Effects → Outline → enable → choose Width and Color.
limits: No inside/center alignment, watercolor border or outline-specific animation; opaque photos outline as rectangles.

features.title: Six perspective guide families
features.summary: Build one-, two-, three-point, parallel, planar or fisheye drawing assistance.
details: Editable geometry, density, area limits and independent display/snapping controls coexist in a shot.
workflow: Guides → choose type → Add → place handles.
limits: This is a native supported subset, not complete Krita assistant compatibility.

features.title: Fixed snapping Ellipse ruler
features.summary: Draw along an editable ellipse or circle.
details: Three placement handles and a center move control define a fixed curve with 12-screen-pixel initial capture.
workflow: Guides → Ellipse ruler → Add → enable snapping → begin near curve.
limits: It is separate from fisheye families, hold-to-shape and animation constraints.

features.title: Reusable .toonguides sets
features.summary: Save and append independent drawing assistants.
details: Sets include guide geometry and shared settings with fresh imported IDs.
workflow: Save guide set, then Add guide set in another drawing.
limits: The native schema does not read/write Krita .paintingassistant files.

features.title: Local perspective detection
features.summary: Propose one/two-point and parallel guides from image edges.
details: Read-only layer/file capture feeds bounded native analysis and editable evidence review.
workflow: Edit → Detect perspective → review model/directions → Add guides.
limits: No automatic three-point/fisheye inference, calibrated accuracy guarantee or regeneration link.

features.title: Region, edge exclusion and two-line correction
features.summary: Repair an ambiguous perspective proposal before acceptance.
details: Region limits evidence; edge toggles refit; manually drawn line pairs supply finite/parallel directions.
workflow: Use Region/Adjust/Two lines in the perspective dialog.
limits: Repeated identical lines cannot locate a unique direction; source/frame changes invalidate stale proposals.

features.title: Offline raster line extraction
features.summary: Turn a selected image/drawing into independent antialiased linework.
details: Detail, Width, Denoise, Smooth, Dust and ink color prepare previewed source-preserving output.
workflow: Edit → Convert to line art → Lines only → compare → Create layers.
limits: No vector output, semantic understanding, saved recipe or direct 3D conversion.

features.title: Cel, grayscale and raster tone output
features.summary: Separate image-derived shading into editable raster layers.
details: Cel bands, grayscale or dots use threshold-ramp and pattern controls alongside extracted lines.
workflow: Choose the conversion output mode and inspect Source/Result before creating layers.
limits: Dark material may enter shade bands; raster dots are not a live DPI-dependent print-tone layer.

features.title: Independent reference-image viewing
features.summary: Study source images beside the drawing without adding artwork layers.
details: Reference navigation and active Eyedropper sampling support visual study.
workflow: Import in References and navigate its view independently.
limits: Reference-image import is distinct from project Assets and artwork image layers.

features.title: Named character model sheets
features.summary: Keep labeled character views together for construction reference.
details: Character reference records and supported imported views live with the native document/project payload.
workflow: Panels → References → Model Sheets → add character → Turnarounds/Expressions/Costumes → import views.
limits: References are native-document scoped, with no automatic synchronization between independent dashboard drawings or generated character artwork.

features.title: Role-based lighting palettes
features.summary: Define approved Day, Night, Sunset and Interior colors.
details: Variants share role IDs while retaining independently edited swatch colors.
workflow: Color Models → select/create character → choose variant → edit roles.
limits: Variants are owned by the current native document, begin as copies and do not automatically relight or repaint pixels.

features.title: Previewed batch character recoloring
features.summary: Map source palette roles into a chosen target variant.
details: Background Before/After previews precede one atomic raster batch Undo.
workflow: Color Models → Recolor drawings → From/To → check drawings → Preview → Apply.
limits: No live palette link; ambiguous mappings and unsupported color mixtures require review.

features.title: Raster Cel Paint Check
features.summary: Inspect holes, islands, leaks and unapproved flat colors.
details: Issue lists, exposure navigation and canvas highlights support artist judgment.
workflow: Panels → Cel Paint Check → choose drawings/palette → Check.
limits: Heuristics can flag intentional shapes and do not inspect composited effects or vector sources.

features.title: Previewed paint-check repairs
features.summary: Repair selected supported issues as one batch.
details: Fill holes, erase checked islands/leaks and replace palette mismatches with preview/original comparison.
workflow: Check intended Problems → Preview → inspect → Apply.
limits: Pixel/issue/size budgets and layer locks can block repair; analysis is not proof that artwork is wrong.

features.title: Saved shadow/highlight boundary drafts
features.summary: Build deliberate shade regions without repainting line art.
details: Explicit guides/fills produce separate Shadows/Highlights layers and save unfinished per-source/frame drafts.
workflow: Cel Shading → choose outline → Boundary/Fill → review → Apply.
limits: Edge-reaching regions are rejected; drafts use their own step-back separate from artwork Undo.

features.title: Embedded Light Table snapshots
features.summary: Overlay movable references for shift-and-trace.
details: Pin sources, place/rotate/scale, solo/flip, Refresh and save embedded snapshots.
workflow: References → Light Table → pin → align → exit editing and draw.
limits: Eight pins share 64 MiB; snapshots update only through explicit Refresh and never export as paint.

features.title: Editable drawing-canvas 3D layers
features.summary: Place a canonical scene inside the actual drawing layer stack.
details: Models, pose, morphs, camera and source assets persist through drawing save/recovery.
workflow: Toolbar cube → Models → Place model, then save the drawing.
limits: Base-color preview is bounded software rendering; direct pixel edits and direct masks/filters are protected.

features.title: Body, head, hand, anime and pet references
features.summary: Browse supplied proportion studies and rigged reference characters.
details: The current catalog includes anatomical presets, Seed-san/Alicia and dog/cat/eagle assets with retained provenance.
workflow: 3D reference → Library → Models → category/search → Place.
limits: Library size/anatomical accuracy/extreme deformation acceptance is not complete product parity.

features.title: Direct 3D FK and basic limb IK
features.summary: Pose supported models with canvas handles and precise controls.
details: Joint rotations, two-bone target/pole controls and supported finger Curl/Spread edit the same native scene.
workflow: Select reference layer → Pose → choose joint/control → drag or enter.
limits: General full-body constraints, image-to-pose inference and unsupported scale chains are not implemented.

features.title: Supported 3D shapes and expressions
features.summary: Adjust supplied studies and actual imported morph targets.
details: Regional body/head/hand controls, weighted recipes and present expressions preserve pose/source ownership.
workflow: 3D Controls → Shape/Face → edit supported values.
limits: Absent uploaded morphs/skeletons are not invented; full VRoid body/hair authoring is incomplete.

features.title: Bounded GLB/glTF/VRM and portable materials
features.summary: Reuse self-contained supported models, scenes and poses.
details: Canonical import, .toon3d scene exchange and typed local materials retain supported source data.
workflow: Use Import or the Materials library and inspect diagnostics.
limits: Partial VRM evaluation; no FBX/OBJ/BVH/CSP material interchange or complete MToon/physics fidelity.

features.title: Draw above a posed 3D reference
features.summary: Return directly from posing to a clean raster drawing layer.
details: Draw above inserts/selects raster artwork above the reference and returns to Brush.
workflow: Pose the model, then click Draw above and sketch.
limits: Raster paint does not modify canonical model geometry; select the reference again to resume posing.

features.title: Guarded background native saves
features.summary: Publish complete revisions without marking newer edits clean.
details: Snapshot/revision guards retain the previous save on cancellation/failure and reject stale publication.
workflow: Save the active document normally and wait for completion.
limits: This is local single-writer storage, not a universal power-loss guarantee.

features.title: Per-document unsaved recovery
features.summary: Offer newer unsaved work when reopening an item.
details: Background recovery runs between committed gestures with a pointer separate from explicit Save.
workflow: Reopen an item and choose the offered recovery when appropriate.
limits: Recovery is bounded, excludes pending uncommitted previews and is not a backup service.

features.title: Verified saved-state project backup
features.summary: Create an independent copy of a consistently saved project.
details: Catalog capture, referenced-file copies and checksums precede backup publication.
workflow: Save dirty tabs, then project actions → Back up saved project.
limits: The command does not automatically save dirty tabs or provide incremental/cloud backups.

features.title: Navigable session artwork History
features.summary: Jump through retained document edits and identify its saved state.
details: Current/redo/clean markers and Undo/Redo navigation share existing bounded history.
workflow: Panels → History → choose a retained state.
limits: Up to 50 commands within memory limits; it resets on load and is not persistent version history.

features.title: Validated native Auto Actions
features.summary: Record supported raster workflows and replay one atomic edit.
details: Relative layer targeting, optional steps and isolated validation prevent partial failed replay.
workflow: Panels → Auto Actions → New → Record supported operations → Stop → Play.
limits: No brush-stroke/animation/3D recording or Photoshop action-file import.

features.title: Frame-by-frame drawing exposures
features.summary: Expose one editable drawing over one or many frames.
details: New/duplicate drawings, holds and raster/vector templates separate artwork from timing.
workflow: New animation → Timeline → drawing track → edit a drawing and its Hold.
limits: Current managed documents are independent one-shot editors, with bounded tracks/drawings/exposures.

features.title: Visual reuse of existing drawings
features.summary: Expose the same source again without duplicating pixels.
details: A thumbnail picker includes names, usage and unused source drawings.
workflow: Timeline → Reuse existing drawing → choose Hold → place in an empty interval.
limits: Editing reused source changes every use; choose Duplicate for independent artwork.

features.title: Multiple-cel timing operations
features.summary: Move, repeat, reverse or retime a selected set of exposures.
details: Range/additive/marquee selection and common holds commit validated batch Undo.
workflow: Select cels, then drag/nudge or choose On 1/2/3, Repeat or Reverse.
limits: Ordinary exposure edits do not retime property keys, camera or audio; collisions reject the batch.

features.title: Saved raster/vector layer templates
features.summary: Create consistent empty drawing structures.
details: Built-in Simple/Rough/Anime and editable named recipes define layer names/order/types.
workflow: Timeline → Add frame-by-frame → edit/save a template.
limits: Templates hold structure, not artwork or brush resources.

features.title: Configurable distinct-drawing onion skin
features.summary: Compare nearby poses without exporting the ghosts.
details: Previous/next counts 0–8, independent colors and shared opacity skip repeated holds/reused copies.
workflow: Enable Onion skin and open its settings.
limits: Overlay is suppressed during playback/Source editing and remains workspace preference state.

features.title: Timeline folders, lock and Solo
features.summary: Organize existing artwork tracks without changing their clocks.
details: Row-header reorder/nesting and visibility/lock share layer rules; Solo isolates preview-only content.
workflow: Use row-header drag or folder actions; toggle Solo for inspection.
limits: Solo does not change exported visibility or mute audio; invalid hierarchy/clipping moves are refused.

features.title: Layer transform and opacity keys
features.summary: Animate placement and coverage independently from exposures.
details: Six base scalar channels support key timing and ordinary batch selection/editing.
workflow: Enable a property diamond, move playhead and edit the value.
limits: Source layer/ancestor locks and project key limits remain active.

features.title: Custom easing and editable motion paths
features.summary: Control temporal spacing and supported spatial motion.
details: Preset/custom outgoing easing, spatial handles, pivots and Follow path retain native keys.
workflow: Select compatible keys/path and adjust its graph or canvas handles.
limits: No general multi-channel value graph or automatic matching of unrelated paths.

features.title: Compatible vector path morph keys
features.summary: Interpolate retained curves when topology is compatible.
details: Source path identity/node correspondence supports evaluated shape animation.
workflow: Use the existing path-key workflow on a compatible vector source.
limits: The app does not automatically match unrelated drawings or morph arbitrary bitmap paintings.

features.title: Supported effect and mask channels
features.summary: Key numeric effects and mask placement while retaining static source images.
details: Effect/Mask categories share scalar interpolation and held enable/invert switches.
workflow: Enable the setting diamond in Effects and edit at the intended frame.
limits: Mask paint and effect colors stay shared static data; Outline has no dedicated channels.

features.title: 2D/3D shot-camera framing keys
features.summary: Animate the rendered frame separately from the editor view.
details: Camera pose keys evaluate with layer/drawing animation for preview and output.
workflow: Use camera properties and the shot Timeline key controls.
limits: Reference-model posing is separate; general rig/model animation and custom camera curves remain open.

features.title: Whole-shot ripple timing
features.summary: Insert, delete or move time across supported shot content.
details: Exposures, keys, camera and audio retime together through isolated validation.
workflow: Timeline → Ripple time → operation/start/length → Apply.
limits: Unrepresentable Symbol clocks/visibility splits and locks reject the complete edit.

features.title: Native-document reusable Symbols
features.summary: Share editable artwork through independent instances.
details: Definitions retain shared source; instances own transforms and compatible playback properties.
workflow: Create a Symbol from supported artwork, then place/edit through its library.
limits: Definitions belong to the current native payload; independent manager documents do not synchronize libraries. Unsupported conversions are refused.

features.title: Finite Symbol clips and frame picking
features.summary: Set visible timing and source-frame playback for an instance.
details: Start/Hold/Slip/First frame and visual pickers keep independent instance clocks.
workflow: Select a Symbol clip and edit its Frame Properties.
limits: Parent timing operations cannot represent every arbitrary split clock.

features.title: Manual timed Symbol poses
features.summary: Hold chosen mouth/expression drawings at explicit parent frames.
details: Per-instance pose keys use a visual source picker and ordinary key editing.
workflow: Symbol → Poses → timed-pose action → choose source drawing.
limits: No interpolation, speech recognition, phoneme inference or automatic lip-sync.

features.title: Markers and dialogue timing cues
features.summary: Annotate shot beats without creating artwork.
details: Marker/Key pose/Breakdown/In-between/Dialogue cues retain text and frame ranges.
workflow: Use the Timeline pin action or M with the timeline grid focused.
limits: Cues are timing references, not drawings, mouth poses or subtitle exchange.

features.title: Embedded waveform audio clips
features.summary: Place supported imported sound in shot time.
details: Qt decoding produces embedded 48 kHz stereo PCM and waveform sources.
workflow: Import Audio, place the clip and adjust its trim/volume.
limits: Codec/device support varies; recording, time stretching and beat detection are absent.

features.title: Fades, gain keys and overlap crossfades
features.summary: Finish the shot-local mix with reversible controls.
details: Linear/Equal-power fades and gain automation share the player/export mixer.
workflow: Select a clip → Audio → Mix → drag fade handles or edit gain keys.
limits: Crossfades require an existing tail/head overlap and do not move clips.

features.title: Audible playhead scrubbing
features.summary: Hear short sound grains while dragging the time ruler.
details: Remembered speaker toggle coalesces short ramped audio preview grains.
workflow: Enable the Timeline speaker and drag the ruler.
limits: Numeric frame entry stays silent; unavailable device output is reported.

features.title: Frame, sheet and PNG-sequence output
features.summary: Render the evaluated frame or production presentation as images.
details: Camera/property effects share output evaluation; sequence export has progress and cancellation.
workflow: Choose File → the matching PNG export.
limits: Movie-frame output excludes paper/header/Notes/ghosts; a cancelled sequence can retain completed frames.

features.title: Runtime-checked MP4 video export
features.summary: Encode a shot with its evaluated artwork and optional mix.
details: Qt Multimedia FFmpeg checks H.264/AAC capability and provides progress/cancellation.
workflow: File → Export video MP4 → choose supported current-shot settings.
limits: Current focused tabs remain current-shot scope; other-platform encoder/package acceptance is separate.

features.title: Mixed PCM WAV export
features.summary: Render a reusable audio mix from supported shot content.
details: 48 kHz stereo 16-bit output includes trims, fades, keys, overlaps and mute.
workflow: File → Export mixed audio WAV → choose range and destination.
limits: RIFF size/output limits are checked; focused managed editors use current-shot scope.

features.title: Optional local RIFE in-betweens
features.summary: Generate raster suggestions between two existing pose drawings.
details: Full-resolution preview, easing, Every frame/On twos and one-Undo insertion preserve endpoint sources.
workflow: Set up runtime, choose endpoint cels, Generate, review and Insert drawings.
limits: Requires the optional helper/model; no vector/layer separation, acting decisions or arbitrary RGBA inference.

features.title: Single-ink transparent RIFE output
features.summary: Reconstruct alpha for a single-color outline transition.
details: Temporary white inputs leave originals unchanged; remembered output mode controls inserted pixels.
workflow: Choose Transparent line art and inspect checkerboard preview before insertion.
limits: White details disappear and colored marks reconstruct to detected ink; use White background for multicolor art.

features.title: Contextual blocked-tool feedback
features.summary: Understand why a canvas action is unavailable.
details: Forbidden cursor, bottom-bar reason and brief warning highlight reflect known tool/layer restrictions.
workflow: Hover or try the current tool, then resolve the stated layer/context restriction.
limits: This explains known restrictions; runtime errors retain their own readable status interval.
